derivation: Use focal length 400 px and calibrated baseline 0.06 m.
At true depth 0.3 m, expected disparity is 80.000000 px.
Disparity sigma=0.5 px propagates to sigma_Z=0.001875 m.
A +1 sigma disparity perturbation gives exact depth 0.298137 m.
Compare the first-order prediction Z-sigma_Z; linearization discrepancy is 0.000012 m.
notes: Depth uncertainty grows quadratically with range in this fixed-camera approximation.
When disparity approaches its uncertainty scale, Gaussian linearization and naive depth estimates become unreliable.
